paper_title: How Knowledge Popularity Influences and Enhances LLM Knowledge Boundary   Perception
caption: The QA performance, confidence, and alignment of Llama3 under different answer popularity.

model_annotations.Bulgarian:
The graph illustrates the relationship between Question Popularity and three metrics: Accuracy, Confidence, and Alignment, for Llama3-8B on Movies. The x-axis, labeled "Question Popularity," has a linear scale and ranges from 0 to 100, with evenly spaced numerical labels at intervals of 20. The y-axis, labeled "Values," also has a linear scale and spans from 0.0 to 1.0, with numerical labels at intervals of 0.2.

The graph contains three lines, each representing a different metric. The blue line, marked with circular markers and a solid style, represents Accuracy. It starts at approximately 0.5 when Question Popularity is 5, increases steadily to around 0.8 at a Question Popularity of 50, and then continues to rise more gradually, reaching about 0.88 at a Question Popularity of 110. The green line, marked with triangular markers and a solid style, represents Confidence. It begins at around 0.84 when Question Popularity is 5, increases to nearly 0.95 at a Question Popularity of 30, remains relatively stable until a Question Popularity of 50, and then slightly increases again, reaching approximately 0.96 at a Question Popularity of 110. The red line, marked with square markers and a solid style, represents Alignment. It starts at about 0.7 when Question Popularity is 5, rises to roughly 0.86 at a Question Popularity of 50, and continues to increase more slowly, reaching approximately 0.9 at a Question Popularity of 110. All three lines exhibit an overall upward trend as Question Popularity increases.
model_annotations.German: The graph displays the relationship between question popularity and three metrics: accuracy, confidence, and alignment, for Llama3-8B on movies. The x-axis represents question popularity, ranging from 0 to 100 in intervals of 20, with a linear scale. The y-axis represents the values of the three metrics, ranging from 0.0 to 1.0 in intervals of 0.2, also with a linear scale. Three lines are plotted: accuracy in blue with circle markers, confidence in green with triangle markers, and alignment in red with square markers. The blue accuracy line starts at approximately 0.52 at a question popularity of 10, increases to around 0.75 at 40, and then gradually rises to about 0.88 at 110. The green confidence line begins at roughly 0.84 at 10, increases to 0.94 at 50, and remains stable at around 0.94 from 50 onwards. The red alignment line starts at approximately 0.73 at 10, shows a slight dip to 0.8 at 20, and then increases to around 0.87 at 50, continuing to rise to about 0.9 at 110.
